the PLACL/AV/1% CUR/MgO nanocomposite scaffolds are promising biocompatible nanofibrous system for breast cancer therapy.

the fabrication of elastomeric nanofibrous composites with potential application in the treatment of breast cancer.
the development of PLACL/AV nanofibers loaded with MgO nanoparticles, CUR and β- CD for the breast cancer treatment.
developing an innovative and effective nanofiber-based drug delivery system for anticancer therapy.

PLACL/AV nanofibers loaded with MgO nanoparticles and CUR/β-CD complex could be a potential candidate for the breast cancer treatment.

PLACL nanofiber loaded with MgO nanoparticles, CUR and β- CD can be a promising material system for anticancer therapy.
the developed nanofibrous scaffold could be used for the treatment of MCF- 7 cancer cells.

the PLACL/AV nanofibrous scaffold with MgO/CUR/β-CD composite can serve as a promising drug delivery system for the treatment of breast cancer cells.
the MgO nanoparticle loaded with CUR in β-CD can be used for breast cancer therapy and the developed nanofibers can be used in the field of biomedical engineering.
